prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A surreal, cinematic portrait of a man seated regally in an ornate armchair, centered in the frame. He wears a sharply tailored dark suit with a crisp white shirt and a black bow tie, exuding an air of formal elegance. His posture is composed and authoritative, hands resting on the armrests, legs slightly apart. Instead of a human head, his visage dissolves into swirling, ethereal smoke, from which a dramatic crown of bare, gnarled tree branches emerges, spreading wide and upward in an almost antler-like formation. The background is minimal and softly lit, with a muted, cool-toned color palette dominated by shades of gray, teal, and subtle hints of brown. The lighting is moody and atmospheric, casting gentle shadows that enhance the surreal, dreamlike quality of the scene. The overall style is hyperrealistic with a touch of dark fantasy, employing a shallow depth of field to keep the focus on the enigmatic figure while the background remains softly blurred. The composition evokes a sense of mystery, power, and otherworldly transformation.
